title: Extraction and PCR for Animal Samples Using TaqPath COVID-19 Combo Kit
author: Brianna Stenger
materials: Thermofisher Scientific TaqPath COVID-19 Combo Kit
Film or foil for sealing plates
If frozen, thaw the reagents on ice. Gently vortex the reagents, then centrifuge briefly to collect liquid at the bottom of the tubes.

Prepare a Master Mix of the PCR reagents containing enough for all samples, controls, plus extra. Master Mix is prepared manually using the volumes in Table 3. Table 3. PCR Reagent Volumes. Nuclease-free Water 12.5 4X TaqPath 1-Step Multiplex MMX (No ROX) 6.25 COVID-19 Real Time PCR Assay Multiplex 1.25 µl MM per rxn 20 Template DNA 5 Total Volume 25

steps.title: Decontaminate Work Area
steps.instruction: Clean the bench with ~10 % bleach or ~70 % ethanol, rinse, then treat with an RNase‑removing solution such as RNaseZAP or Eliminase.

steps.title: Prepare Binding Bead/Lysis Mix
steps.instruction: For the required number of reactions, combine Binding Solution, Nucleic Acid Magnetic Beads, Proteinase K, and MS2 Phage Control according to Table 1 (e.g., for 110 reactions: 58.3 mL Binding Solution, 2.2 mL beads, total 60.5 mL mix). Vortex the bead suspension to homogenize, invert the mixture five times gently, then store at room temperature. Use a new tip for each well when pipetting this viscous mix.

substeps.instruction: Calculate volumes per reaction (530 µL Binding Solution, 20 µL beads per sample).
Store the prepared mix at room temperature.

steps.title: Set Up Extraction Plates
steps.instruction: Follow Table 2 to assemble the KingFisher™ Deepwell 96 sample plate, wash plates, and elution plate: add 10 µL Proteinase K, 400 µL sample, 550 µL prepared bead/lysis mix (use a new tip for each well), and 10 µL MS2 Phage Control to each sample well; add 1 000 µL Wash Buffer to Wash 1 plate; add 1 000 µL 80 % ethanol to Wash 2 plate; add 50 µL Elution Solution to the elution plate; place a 96‑tip comb for DW magnets in the KingFisher 96 microplate. Avoid DEPC‑treated water, cover wash and elution plates with seals to prevent evaporation, and use fresh tips for bead/lysis mix due to foaming.

substeps.instruction: Add Proteinase K, sample, bead mix, and MS2 to each well of the sample plate.
Load Wash 1 plate with 1 000 µL Wash Buffer per well.
Load Wash 2 plate with 1 000 µL 80 % ethanol per well.
Load Elution plate with 50 µL Elution Solution per well.
Place KingFisher 96‑tip comb in the appropriate microplate.
Seal wash and elution plates if loading will be delayed.

steps.title: Seal Sample Plate and Transport
steps.instruction: After adding samples and controls, seal the sample plate tightly with film, wipe the exterior with disinfectant, place the sealed plate in a transport container, disinfect the container, and bring it to the biosafety cabinet in the extraction room.

steps.title: Load Plates onto KingFisher
steps.instruction: Place the prepared sample plate, Wash 1 plate, Wash 2 plate, and elution plate into the KingFisher™ Flex Magnetic Particle Processor as prompted by the instrument.

steps.title: Run Extraction Program
steps.instruction: Select the program “MVP_2Wash_400_Flex” on the KingFisher Flex with the 96‑Deep‑Well head, then start the run. The extraction run lasts approximately 24 minutes.

steps.title: Collect and Store Eluted RNA
steps.instruction: Immediately after the run, remove the elution plate, cover it with film/foil to prevent evaporation, and store the plate at 4 °C, –20 °C, or –70 °C for up to 48 hours.

steps.title: Prepare Diluted Positive Control
steps.instruction: Create two sequential dilutions of the TaqPath™ COVID‑19 Control:

substeps.instruction: Pipet 98 µL TaqPath™ COVID‑19 Control Dilution Buffer into a tube, add 2 µL TaqPath™ COVID‑19 Control, mix well, and centrifuge briefly.
Pipet 87.5 µL Dilution Buffer into a second tube, add 12.5 µL of the first dilution, mix well, and centrifuge briefly. (The positive control does not contain MS2 phage.)

steps.title: Add Samples and Controls to PCR Plate
steps.instruction: To each well of the PCR plate add 5 µL extracted RNA (or 5 µL nuclease‑free water for the negative extraction control) to reach a total reaction volume of 25 µL. For the positive‑control well, add 2 µL of the diluted positive control and 3 µL nuclease‑free water. Seal the plate thoroughly after adding all samples and controls.

steps.title: Add Master Mix and Mix
steps.instruction: Pipette 20 µL of the TaqPath COVID‑19 Combo Kit master mix into each well, then vortex the plate at high speed for 10–30 seconds using a plate‑holder attachment to avoid well damage.

steps.title: Centrifuge PCR Plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sealed PCR plate for 2 minutes at approximately 600 × g (manufacturer recommends ≥650 × g) to remove bubbles and collect liquid at the bottom of the wells.

steps.title: Configure Thermal Cycler
steps.instruction: Program an ABI 7500 Fast or ABI 7500 DX thermal cycler with the following settings (Table 5) and target dye assignments (Table 4): UNG incubation 25 °C 2 min; Reverse transcription 53 °C 10 min; Activation 95 °C 2 min; Denaturation 95 °C 3 sec for 40 cycles; Anneal/extension 60 °C 30 sec. Assign dyes: ORF1ab – FAM, N – VIC, S – ABY, MS2 – JUN.

steps.title: Run RT‑PCR Program
steps.instruction: Start the real‑time RT‑PCR run using the programmed conditions. Monitor amplification curves for each target.

steps.title: Verify Control Wells
steps.instruction: Ensure each run contains at least one negative extraction control and one positive amplification control; include additional negative controls for each extraction plate. All control wells must pass for the run to be considered valid.
